info.name: Vegetable Marakesh Meal
info.description: Vegetable Marakesh is a vibrant dish featuring a mix of fresh vegetables cooked in a fragrant, spiced sauce with Moroccan influences. This dish offers a flavorful and aromatic experience, combining a variety of textures and tastes.

info.name: Vegetable Chelo Kebab
info.description: Vegetable Chelo Kabab consists of skewered spiced vegetables grilled to perfection. These kababs offer a flavorful, healthy option with a smoky char and a blend of aromatic spices, ideal for vegetarians and those seeking a lighter option.

info.name: Original Chelo Kebab Meal
info.description: Chelo Kababs are traditional Persian-inspired kebabs made with spiced minced meat, grilled to perfection. Known for their aromatic flavors and tender texture, these kababs are a classic choice for a flavorful and satisfying meal.

info.name: Chicken Marakesh Meal
info.description: Chicken Marakesh features tender chicken pieces cooked in a spiced sauce with Moroccan-inspired flavors. The dish combines aromatic spices and herbs to create a richly flavored and satisfying meal.

info.name: Mutton Chelo Kebab
info.description: Mutton Chelo Kabab features spiced minced mutton formed into skewers and grilled to a tender, flavorful finish. This dish combines traditional spices with a classic grilling technique to deliver a rich and savory kabab experience.

info.name: Cream of Asparagus Soup
info.description: A velvety and smooth soup featuring tender asparagus blended into a rich, creamy base. Infused with delicate herbs and spices, this soup offers a fresh and refined flavor that highlights the subtle sweetness of asparagus.

info.name: Cream of Tomato Soup
info.description: Cream of Tomato is a classic soup made with ripe tomatoes pureed into a silky, creamy base. Enhanced with aromatic herbs and a touch of cream, it offers a rich, tangy flavor that's both comforting and delicious.

info.name: Cream of Vegetable Soup
info.description: A hearty and wholesome soup featuring a medley of fresh vegetables pureed into a creamy, smooth texture. Flavored with a blend of herbs and spices, it provides a rich, nourishing experience with a subtle, natural sweetness from the vegetables.

info.name: Minestrone Italienne Soup
info.description: Minestrone Italienne is a robust Italian soup packed with a variety of vegetables, beans, and pasta. Simmered in a tomato-based broth with herbs and spices, it offers a hearty and flavorful dish that embodies the essence of classic Italian comfort food.

info.name: Cream of Spring Chicken Soup
info.description: Cream of Spring Chicken is a light and creamy soup featuring tender chicken pieces with a touch of spring vegetables. Flavored with fresh herbs and a velvety base, it provides a refreshing and comforting option.

info.name: Fresh Salad
info.description: Fresh Salad consists of a crisp mix of seasonal vegetables, such as lettuce, cucumbers, and tomatoes, tossed with a light dressing. This refreshing and healthy side provides a cool contrast to rich and spicy main dishes.

info.name: Russian Salad
info.description: Russian Salad is a creamy, chilled salad made with a blend of diced vegetables, fruits, and mayonnaise. Its rich, tangy flavor and smooth texture make it a delightful and refreshing side dish.

info.name: Potato Salad
info.description: Potato Salad features tender, boiled potatoes mixed with a creamy dressing, fresh herbs, and sometimes a touch of mustard or pickles. This hearty and flavorful side dish offers a comforting and satisfying taste.

info.name: Paneer Tikka Kebab [6 Pcs]
info.description:
Paneer Tikka Kebab showcases marinated paneer cubes grilled to perfection. The paneer is seasoned with a blend of spices and yogurt, resulting in a smoky, flavorful kabab with a charred exterior and a soft, creamy interior.
Served with Rice.

info.name: Veg Seekh Kebab [4 Pcs]
info.description: Veg. Sheek Kabab consists of spiced, minced vegetables formed into skewers and grilled until golden-brown. These kababs offer a flavorful and satisfying vegetarian option with a smoky char and a blend of aromatic spices.

info.name: Tandoori Aloo [8 Pcs]
info.description: Tandoori Aloo features potato wedges marinated in a spiced yogurt mixture and cooked in a tandoor. The result is a smoky, flavorful dish with a crispy exterior and tender, spiced interior, making it an ideal appetizer or side.

info.name: Tandoori Broccoli [4 Pcs]
info.description: Tandoori Broccoli consists of broccoli florets marinated in a blend of yogurt and tandoori spices, then grilled to perfection. The dish offers a smoky, spiced flavor with a crispy texture, ideal for a healthy and flavorful appetizer.

info.name: Paneer Irani Kebab [8 Pcs]
info.description: Paneer Irani Kabab features marinated paneer cubes grilled to perfection. Infused with aromatic spices and herbs, these kababs are tender and flavorful, offering a delightful vegetarian option with a touch of Persian influence.

info.name: Todays Chefs Special Chicken Kebab [8 Pcs]
info.description: Today's Special Chicken Kabab offers a unique twist on traditional kababs with a special marinade or preparation chosen by the chef. Featuring expertly grilled chicken with distinctive flavors, this dish provides a delightful and flavorful experience.

info.name: Chicken Irani Kebab [8 Pcs]
info.description: Chicken Irani Kabab showcases marinated chicken pieces grilled with a blend of aromatic Persian spices. The kababs offer a juicy, flavorful taste with a tender texture and a hint of smokiness, inspired by traditional Irani recipes.

info.name: Chicken Reshmi Kebab [8 Pcs]
info.description: Chicken Reshmi Kabab features marinated chicken grilled to a tender, juicy perfection. The chicken is coated in a creamy, spiced marinade that delivers a rich, smooth flavor with a subtle hint of herbs and spices.

info.name: Chicken Tandoori Half [2 Pcs]
info.description: Chicken Tandoori Half presents a marinated half-chicken cooked in a tandoor, resulting in a smoky, charred exterior and a juicy, flavorful interior. The marinade, made from yogurt and a blend of spices, imparts a rich, aromatic taste.

info.name: Chicken Tandoori Full [4 Pcs]
info.description: Chicken Tandoori Full features a whole chicken marinated in a blend of yogurt, spices, and herbs, then cooked in a tandoor. The result is a smoky, flavorful dish with a crispy, charred exterior and tender, juicy meat inside, offering a robust and aromatic taste.

info.name: Chicken Tikka Kebab [8 Pcs]
info.description: Chicken Tikka Kabab consists of succulent chunks of chicken marinated in a spiced yogurt mixture, skewered, and grilled to perfection. This dish offers a smoky flavor with a tender texture and a burst of spices, making it a popular choice for a delicious appetizer or main course.

info.name: Mutton Pishori Kebab [4 Pcs]
info.description: Mutton Pishori Kabab features spiced minced mutton formed into skewers and grilled to perfection. Infused with a mix of traditional spices, these kababs deliver a rich, savory flavor and a tender, juicy texture.

info.name: Mutton Shikar [8 Pcs]
info.description: Shikar features tender, boneless pieces of mutton marinated and cooked with a blend of spices and herbs. The result is a richly flavored, succulent dish with a melt-in-your-mouth texture, perfect for those who enjoy tender and flavorful meat.

info.name: Mutton Seekh Kebab [4 Pcs]
info.description: Sheek Kabab consists of spiced minced mutton formed onto skewers and grilled until golden-brown. These kababs offer a juicy, flavorful experience with a perfect balance of spices and a tender texture, making them a favorite for meat lovers.

info.name: Mutton Dum Ki Raan Half
info.description: Dum-Ki-Raan Half presents a portion of the slow-cooked leg of mutton, marinated and cooked with a blend of spices. This dish offers the same tender, flavorful experience as the full version, but in a more manageable portion size.

info.name: Fish Makhmali [5 Pcs]
info.description: Fish Makhmali showcases tender fish fillets marinated in a creamy, spiced yogurt mixture and then grilled to perfection. This dish offers a delicate, smooth flavor with a touch of richness and a hint of smokiness.

info.name: Mutton Dum Ki Raan Full
info.description: Dum-Ki-Raan Full features a whole leg of mutton slow-cooked with aromatic spices and herbs in its own juices. The slow cooking process ensures the meat is incredibly tender and flavorful, offering a rich and hearty dish ideal for sharing.

info.name: Fish Farah Kebab [5 Pcs]
info.description: Farah features fish kababs delicately seasoned with a blend of herbs and spices, then grilled to achieve a tender, flavorful bite. This dish offers a light yet flavorful option with a hint of smokiness and a perfectly seasoned taste.

info.name: Tandoori Prawns [6 Pcs]
info.description: Tandoori Prawns are marinated in a blend of yogurt and tandoori spices, then grilled to achieve a smoky flavor and tender texture. The prawns are infused with aromatic spices and herbs, delivering a flavorful and succulent seafood dish.

info.name: Chilli Chicken [8 Pcs]
info.description: Chilli Chicken is a savory dish with tender chicken pieces stir-fried in a spicy and tangy sauce with bell peppers, onions, and a hint of garlic. The combination of bold flavors and a crispy texture makes it a favorite appetizer or main course.

info.name: Chilli Paneer [6 Pcs]
info.description: Chili Paneer consists of cubes of paneer cheese stir-fried in a spicy, tangy chili sauce with bell peppers and onions. This dish offers a flavorful combination of heat and sweetness, with a satisfying texture.

info.name: Afghani Chicken
info.description: Afghani Chicken is marinated in a blend of yogurt, spices, and herbs, then grilled or baked to perfection. This dish offers a tender, juicy texture with a subtle yet rich flavor profile, inspired by traditional Afghan cuisine.

info.name: Chilli Fish [8 Pcs]
info.description: Chilli Fish consists of crispy fried fish pieces tossed in a spicy, tangy chili sauce with bell peppers and onions. The dish delivers a satisfying crunch with a bold and flavorful sauce, perfect for those who enjoy a bit of heat.

info.name: Chilli Prawns [6 Pcs]
info.description: Chilli Prawn features succulent prawns stir-fried in a spicy, tangy chili sauce with bell peppers and onions. The dish offers a vibrant blend of flavors, with a spicy kick and a touch of sweetness, making it a popular choice for seafood lovers.

info.name: Chilli Potato
info.description: Chili Potato is a popular appetizer made with crispy potato wedges tossed in a tangy and spicy chili sauce. Garnished with fresh cilantro and a sprinkle of sesame seeds, this dish offers a satisfying crunch and a bold, flavorful kick.

info.name: Vegetable Shami Kebab [4 Pcs]
info.description: Vegetable Shammi Kabab consists of spiced and seasoned vegetable patties, pan-fried to a golden-brown perfection. These kababs offer a flavorful and savory option with a crispy exterior and a soft, spiced interior.

info.name: Rajma Galauti Kebab [4 Pcs]
info.description: Rajma Galaouti Kabab is a unique take on traditional kababs, made from spiced kidney beans and blended into a smooth, flavorful mixture. These kababs are grilled or pan-fried to achieve a crispy outer layer and a soft, tender inside, offering a delicious vegetarian alternative.

info.name: Chilli Baby Corn
info.description: Chili Babycorn consists of crisp baby corn stir-fried with a tangy, spicy chili sauce, garlic, and bell peppers. This vibrant dish offers a satisfying crunch with a bold and spicy kick, ideal for a lively appetizer or side.

info.name: Cold Chicken and Salad
info.description: Cold Chicken & Salad presents tender, chilled chicken slices paired with a crisp, refreshing salad of mixed greens, vegetables, and a light vinaigrette. This dish is perfect for a light, healthy meal or a satisfying starter.

info.name: Chicken Cocktail Sausage
info.description: Chicken Cocktail Sausages are bite-sized, flavorful sausages made from seasoned chicken and grilled to perfection. Served with a tangy dipping sauce, these mini sausages offer a tasty and easy-to-enjoy appetizer.

info.name: Fried Chicken Liver
info.description: Fried Chicken Liver features tender chicken livers seasoned with a blend of spices, then coated and fried to a crispy golden-brown. The result is a rich, savory appetizer with a crunchy exterior and a smooth, flavorful interior.

info.name: Mutton Shammi Kebab [3 Pcs]
info.description: Mutton Shammi Kabab consists of spiced and minced mutton patties, cooked until tender and golden-brown. These kababs offer a rich, savory flavor with a smooth texture, making them a delicious and satisfying option.

info.name: Nalli Mutton Ghost Dry
info.description: Tender lamb shanks simmered until succulent, then sauteed with a blend of aromatic spices for a richly flavored dry curry with a hint of heat.

info.name: Prawn Cocktail [12-13 Pcs]
info.description: Prawn Cocktail features succulent prawns served chilled in a tangy, creamy cocktail sauce. Garnished with fresh herbs and lemon, this classic dish provides a refreshing and elegant seafood starter with a perfect balance of sweetness and acidity.

info.name: Paneer Makhani Masala
info.description: Cubes of soft paneer in a creamy, buttery tomato gravy infused with a mix of spices and garnished with fresh coriander, creating a rich and indulgent vegetarian dish.

info.name: Paneer Tikka Masala
info.description: Marinated paneer chunks grilled to perfection and then cooked in a luscious, spiced tomato sauce with a touch of cream, offering a smoky and savory delight.

info.name: Nentara
info.description: Beans+carrots+potatoes prepared with indian sauces and spices.

info.name: Dal Butter Fry
info.description: Hearty lentils cooked with a generous amount of butter and a medley of spices, offering a rich, savory flavor that's both comforting and satisfying.

info.name: Aloo Matar
info.description: A classic combination of tender potatoes and green peas in a spiced tomato-based gravy, delivering a comforting and well-balanced vegetarian curry.

info.name: Kabuli King Chic Peas
info.description: Chickpeas simmered in a robust, spiced gravy with a touch of royal flavor, creating a hearty and flavorful vegetarian dish.

info.name: Vegetable Begum Bahar
info.description: A medley of fresh vegetables cooked in a creamy, mildly spiced sauce, offering a rich and aromatic dish that's both flavorful and satisfying.

info.name: Malai Kofta
info.description: Soft, spiced paneer and potato dumplings simmered in a velvety, rich tomato-based sauce with a touch of cream, perfect for a decadent vegetarian feast.

info.name: Palak Paneer
info.description: Cubed paneer cooked in a smooth spinach gravy with a blend of spices, creating a vibrant and nutritious dish that's both flavorful and creamy.

info.name: Palak Cream
info.description: A rich and creamy spinach sauce with a delicate balance of spices, offering a luxurious vegetarian dish that's perfect for pairing with naan or rice.

info.name: Matar Paneer
info.description: Paneer and peas cooked together in a spiced tomato gravy, combining the creaminess of paneer with the freshness of peas for a classic, satisfying curry.

info.name: Chicken Shah Nauz
info.description: Shah Nauz is a flavorful dish made with tender pieces of meat or poultry cooked in a spiced gravy with a blend of aromatic ingredients. This dish delivers a rich, savory flavor with a touch of elegance.

info.name: Chicken Harem's Joy
info.description: Harem's Joy features a flavorful mix of spiced meats or vegetables cooked in a rich, aromatic sauce. This dish combines a variety of textures and tastes to create a satisfying and memorable dining experience.

info.name: Mutton Nawabi
info.description: Nawabi is a regal dish featuring tender meat cooked in a rich, creamy gravy with a blend of aromatic spices and nuts. This dish offers a luxurious and flavorful experience, perfect for those seeking an indulgent and hearty meal.

info.name: Egg Curry
info.description: Egg Curry is a flavorful dish where hard-boiled eggs are simmered in a spiced, tangy tomato-based gravy. The curry is enriched with aromatic herbs and spices, creating a savory and satisfying dish that pairs perfectly with rice or naan.

info.name: Chicken Curry
info.description: A hearty and aromatic dish featuring tender pieces of chicken simmered in a spiced tomato and onion gravy. Flavored with a blend of traditional Indian spices, garlic, ginger, and fresh herbs, this curry offers a rich, savory experience with a hint of heat.

info.name: Chicken Saag
info.description: Tender chicken pieces cooked with spinach and a blend of spices, merging the savory flavors of chicken with the earthy goodness of spinach for a hearty, nutritious meal.

info.name: Chicken Shahi Korma
info.description: A royal delicacy with succulent chicken pieces cooked in a creamy, spiced yogurt and almond sauce. This dish combines rich flavors and a smooth texture

info.name: Chicken Bharta
info.description: Chicken Bharta features grilled chicken thats finely shredded and incorporated into a savory tomato-based gravy. Cooked with a blend of onions, garlic, ginger, and spices, this dish offers a smoky, rich flavor and a satisfying texture that highlights the essence of traditional Indian cuisine.

info.name: Chicken Butter Masala
info.description: Chicken Butter Masala is a beloved classic, where juicy chicken pieces are bathed in a luscious, creamy tomato sauce. Infused with butter, cream, and a balanced mix of spices, this dish delivers a rich, indulgent flavor with a smooth and velvety texture that pairs perfectly with naan or rice.

info.name: Chicken Liver Masala
info.description: Chicken Liver Masala features tender chicken livers simmered in a robust, spicy gravy made with onions, tomatoes, and a variety of aromatic spices. The dish offers a deep, savory flavor profile and a rich, hearty texture thats perfect for those who enjoy bold, flavorful cuisine.

info.name: Chicken Reshmi Butter Masala
info.description: Chicken Reshmi Butter Masala showcases marinated chicken grilled to perfection and then enveloped in a silky, buttery sauce. This creamy curry is enriched with a blend of spices and a hint of sweetness, creating a luxurious and satisfying dish with a smooth, refined taste.

info.name: Keema Matar Aloo Egg
info.description: Keema Mattar Aloo Egg features spiced minced meat (keema) cooked with tender peas (mattar), potatoes (aloo), and boiled eggs. This hearty dish combines rich flavors with a satisfying blend of textures, offering a robust, savory meal that's both comforting and filling.

info.name: Nalli Gosht Gravy
info.description: Nalli Gosht is a hearty lamb shank curry where tender meat is slow-cooked in a deeply flavored, spiced gravy. The slow simmering process ensures the lamb becomes incredibly tender, while the rich, aromatic sauce delivers a satisfying and robust flavor with a touch of heat.

info.name: Mutton Rogan Josh
info.description: Mutton Rogan Josh is a signature Kashmiri dish featuring tender mutton pieces cooked in a richly spiced gravy with a blend of fragrant herbs and spices. The result is a deeply flavorful and aromatic curry, renowned for its vibrant color and comforting, satisfying taste.

info.name: Mutton Do Pyaza
info.description: Mutton Dopiaza offers a flavorful blend of tender mutton and a generous amount of caramelized onions. Simmered in a spiced gravy, this dish features layers of rich flavor and a hearty texture, making it a favorite for those who enjoy a robust and savory curry.

info.name: Mutton Badam Pasanda
info.description: A luxurious and flavorful dish where tender mutton pieces are cooked in a creamy sauce made with ground almonds, yogurt, and a blend of aromatic spices. The rich, nutty sauce is infused with cardamom, cloves, and cinnamon, creating a rich and indulgent curry with a delicate balance of spice and sweetness.

info.name: Mutton Saag Meat
info.description: Sag Meat combines succulent mutton pieces with fresh spinach, creating a dish that balances the richness of the meat with the vibrant flavors of the greens. Cooked with a blend of spices, this hearty and nutritious curry delivers a satisfying and well-rounded flavor experience.

info.name: Mutton Masala
info.description: Mutton Masala features tender chunks of mutton simmered in a spiced, aromatic gravy made with a mix of traditional Indian spices. This dish offers a robust flavor profile and a rich, hearty texture, making it a perfect choice for a filling and flavorful meal.

info.name: Mutton Brain Masala
info.description: Brain Masala features tender pieces of lamb or goat brain cooked in a rich, spiced gravy with onions, tomatoes, and a blend of aromatic spices. This dish offers a unique, creamy texture and a deeply flavorful, savory experience for adventurous diners.

info.name: Fish Masala
info.description: Fish Masala features tender fish fillets cooked in a fragrant, spiced masala gravy. The dish is infused with a blend of aromatic spices and fresh herbs, resulting in a flavorful and well-balanced curry that complements the delicate taste of the fish.

info.name: Fish Curry
info.description: Fish Curry presents fresh fish pieces simmered in a tangy, spicy sauce made with a blend of traditional spices. The currys vibrant flavors and rich gravy make it a delightful choice for seafood enthusiasts seeking a hearty and satisfying meal.

info.name: Prawns Butter Masala
info.description: Prawn Butter Masala highlights succulent prawns cooked in a rich, creamy butter sauce. The dish is flavored with a delicate mix of spices and herbs, creating a luxurious curry thats both indulgent and satisfying, perfect for a special treat.

info.name: Prawns Curry
info.description: Prawn Curry features juicy prawns simmered in a spiced, tangy sauce with a blend of fresh herbs and aromatic spices. This dish offers a vibrant, flavorful experience with a balance of heat and tanginess, ideal for those who enjoy bold and savory seafood dishes.

info.name: Fish Makhmali [Serves 2]
info.description: Tender fish fillets cooked in a rich, creamy sauce with aromatic spices, offering a melt-in-the-mouth texture and balanced flavors. Perfect for sharing

info.name: Kabuli Naan
info.description: Kabuli Nan is a traditional naan bread filled with a blend of spiced ingredients, such as nuts and dried fruits. Baked to a golden perfection, it offers a slightly sweet and savory flavor, ideal for pairing with rich curries and stews.

info.name: Naan
info.description: Nan is a classic Indian flatbread baked in a tandoor, offering a soft, fluffy texture with a slightly crisp exterior. Perfect for scooping up curries or stews, this traditional bread is a versatile and essential part of any Indian meal.

info.name: Lasooni Naan
info.description: Lasooni Nan is a flavorful naan bread infused with garlic and herbs. Baked to a golden-brown crisp, this aromatic bread offers a savory garlic flavor, making it a perfect accompaniment to rich and spicy dishes.

info.name: Makhani Naan
info.description: Makhan Nan is a rich, buttery naan bread baked to a golden perfection. Infused with a generous amount of butter, it offers a soft, fluffy texture with a slightly crisp exterior, ideal for pairing with flavorful curries and gravies.

info.name: Pea Paratha
info.description: Pea Paratha is a whole wheat flatbread stuffed with a spiced mixture of green peas and herbs. Grilled to a crispy golden-brown, it offers a savory and satisfying filling with a tender, flaky texture, perfect for a hearty breakfast or lunch.

info.name: Paratha
info.description: Paratha is a classic Indian flatbread made from whole wheat flour and cooked on a griddle to a crispy, golden-brown finish. Its layered texture and slightly flaky crust make it an excellent accompaniment to curries, dals, and vegetables.

info.name: Tandoori Roti
info.description: Tandoori Roti is a traditional whole wheat flatbread baked in a tandoor, resulting in a smoky flavor and a crisp, slightly charred exterior. Its soft interior and hearty texture make it a versatile side for a variety of Indian dishes.

info.name: Butter Roti
info.description: Butter Roti is a soft, whole wheat flatbread lightly brushed with butter after cooking. Its tender, fluffy texture and subtle buttery flavor make it a delicious accompaniment to rich and flavorful curries and gravies.

info.name: Masala Kulcha
info.description: Masala Kulcha is a flavorful, stuffed Indian bread made with a blend of spiced potatoes and herbs. Baked in a tandoor, this bread has a soft, pillowy texture with a spiced filling that adds a delightful burst of flavor to any meal.

info.name: Keema Naan
info.description: Keema Nan is a stuffed bread filled with spiced minced meat. Baked to a golden-brown perfection, this naan offers a savory filling with a soft, fluffy exterior, making it a delicious and hearty accompaniment to any meal.

info.name: Persian Pulao
info.description: Persian Pallao is a fragrant rice dish cooked with a blend of aromatic spices, saffron, and tender meat or vegetables. The rice is fluffy and flavorful, reflecting traditional Persian culinary techniques and offering a rich, exotic taste.

info.name: Plain Pulao
info.description: Plain Pallao is a simple yet flavorful rice dish cooked with aromatic spices and herbs. The rice is fluffy and light, making it a versatile side dish that pairs well with a variety of curries and stews.

info.name: Pea Pulao
info.description: Pea Pallao is a fragrant rice dish cooked with green peas and aromatic spices. The fluffy rice is enhanced with a delicate blend of spices, offering a light and flavorful side that complements a range of main courses.

info.name: Veg Biryani
info.description: Biryani is a fragrant rice dish layered with spiced meat and aromatic herbs, slow-cooked to perfection. This rich and flavorful biryani combines tender meat with spiced rice, offering a hearty and satisfying meal.

info.name: Chicken biryani
info.description: Biryani Ala Kashmiri is a fragrant rice dish with a blend of spices, dried fruits, and tender meat or vegetables. This Kashmiri-style biryani features a unique combination of sweet and savory flavors, offering a rich and exotic taste.

info.name: Mutton Biryani
info.description: Biryani Ala Nawabi is a rich and aromatic rice dish layered with spiced meat and slow-cooked to perfection. Infused with luxurious spices and herbs, it offers a regal and flavorful dining experience reminiscent of Nawabi cuisine.

info.name: Vegetable Fried Rice
info.description: Vegetable Fried Rice features fluffy rice stir-fried with a mix of fresh vegetables, soy sauce, and spices. This colorful and flavorful dish offers a satisfying and hearty option, perfect as a side or a main course.

info.name: Egg Fried Rice
info.description: Egg Fried Rice is a classic stir-fried rice dish with scrambled eggs, mixed vegetables, and a touch of soy sauce. Its light, flavorful profile and hearty texture make it a versatile and comforting option.

info.name: Chicken Fried Rice
info.description: Chicken Fried Rice features stir-fried rice with tender pieces of chicken, mixed vegetables, and a savory sauce. This satisfying dish offers a balanced blend of flavors and textures, perfect as a standalone meal or a side.

info.name: Vegetable Gratin
info.description: Vegetable Gratin features layers of mixed vegetables baked in a creamy cheese sauce until golden and bubbly. This rich and comforting dish provides a savory blend of flavors and textures, with a crispy top and tender vegetables.

info.name: Veg Masala Gratin
info.description: Masala Gratin is a creamy, baked dish featuring layers of spiced vegetables or meat, topped with a cheesy crust. The blend of spices and cheese creates a flavorful and indulgent dish with a satisfying texture.

info.name: Vegetable Steak
info.description: Vegetable Steak is a hearty dish featuring thick, grilled slices of marinated vegetables. Served with a savory sauce, it offers a satisfying and flavorful vegetarian option that mimics the texture and presentation of a traditional steak.

info.name: Egg Mayonnaise
info.description: Egg Mayonnaise consists of hard-boiled eggs mixed with a creamy mayonnaise dressing. Seasoned with herbs and spices, this dish offers a smooth, rich flavor and is typically served as a refreshing appetizer or side.

info.name: Baked Chicken
info.description: Baked Chicken features juicy chicken pieces seasoned with herbs and spices, then baked to golden perfection. The result is a tender, flavorful dish with a crispy exterior, ideal for a wholesome and healthy meal.

info.name: Fried Chicken
info.description: Fried Chicken consists of crispy, golden-brown chicken pieces coated in a seasoned flour mixture and deep-fried to perfection. Each bite delivers a crunchy exterior and juicy, flavorful meat, making it a popular comfort food favorite.

info.name: Roasted Chicken
info.description: Roast Chicken is a classic dish where a whole chicken is marinated with a blend of spices and herbs, then roasted until crispy and golden. The slow-roasting process ensures the meat is tender and flavorful, offering a succulent and satisfying main course.

info.name: Cold Chicken and Salad
info.description: Cold Chicken & Salad features chilled chicken slices served with a fresh mix of greens and vegetables. The dish is accompanied by a light dressing, offering a refreshing and healthy option for a light meal.

info.name: Chicken Mayonnaise
info.description: Chicken Mayonnaise is a creamy dish featuring tender chicken pieces coated in a rich mayonnaise dressing. The dish is often garnished with herbs and served chilled, offering a smooth and flavorful taste.

info.name: Grilled Chicken
info.description: Juicy chicken marinated in herbs and spices, grilled to perfection with a smoky finish.

info.name: Fish & Chips with Tartar Sauce
info.description: Fried Bhetki features crispy, golden-brown fish fillets served with a classic tartare sauce. The crunchy exterior and tender fish inside are perfectly complemented by the creamy, tangy tartare sauce.

info.name: Fish in Lemon Butter Sauce
info.description: Bhetki Meunier features tender fish fillets coated in a seasoned breadcrumb mixture and fried until crispy. The dish is served with a creamy, lemon-infused sauce, adding a tangy complement to the crispy fish.

info.name: Grilled Bhetki with Sauce [2 Pcs]
info.description: Grilled Bhetki served with roasted potatoes consists of fish fillets grilled to perfection and served with a flavorful sauce. The grilling process imparts a smoky flavor, and the accompanying sauce enhances the dish with additional layers of taste.

info.name: Fried Prawns
info.description: Fried Prawns are succulent prawns coated in a seasoned batter and deep-fried until crispy. Each bite offers a crunchy exterior with tender, juicy prawns inside, making them a popular and flavorful appetizer.

info.name: Vegetable Burger
info.description: Vegetable Burger is a hearty patty made from a blend of vegetables, grains, and spices, served in a bun with lettuce, tomatoes, and condiments. This flavorful and satisfying option is perfect for vegetarians or anyone seeking a healthy alternative.

info.name: Chicken Burger
info.description: Chicken Burger includes a tender chicken patty seasoned and cooked to perfection, served in a bun with fresh vegetables, cheese, and condiments. This flavorful and satisfying burger offers a delicious alternative to traditional beef burgers.

info.name: Mutton Burger
info.description: Mutton Burger features a juicy patty made from seasoned minced mutton, served in a bun with lettuce, tomatoes, and condiments. The rich and flavorful mutton patty provides a satisfying and hearty burger experience.

info.name: Mutton Ham Steak Burger
info.description: Mutton Hamburger Steak features seasoned mutton patties grilled or pan-seared to a juicy finish. Served with a savory sauce, this dish offers a rich and flavorful alternative to traditional beef hamburgers.

info.name: Vegetable Club Sandwich
info.description: Vegetable Club is a hearty sandwich layered with fresh vegetables, cheese, and condiments between toasted bread. It offers a satisfying crunch and a burst of flavors, making it a wholesome and tasty option for a light meal.

info.name: Vegetable Sandwich
info.description: Fresh, crisp vegetables layered between slices of whole grain bread with a tangy spread.

info.name: Cheese Sandwich

info.name: Grilled Cheese Sandwich

info.name: Egg Sandwich

info.name: Chicken Club Sandwich

info.name: Chicken Sandwich

info.name: Grilled Chicken and Cheese Sandwich
info.description: Tender grilled chicken and melted cheese nestled between crispy, toasted bread with a hint of seasoning.

info.name: Dinner Roll
info.description: Soft and fluffy, Dinner Rolls are baked to perfection with a golden-brown crust and a tender, airy interior. These rolls are ideal for sopping up soups, stews, or enjoying with butter for a comforting side.

info.name: Vegetable Pakoda [6 Pcs]
info.description: Vegetable Pakora consists of assorted vegetables dipped in a spiced gram flour batter and deep-fried until crispy. These bite-sized fritters offer a crunchy exterior and a flavorful, spiced vegetable interior.

info.name: Paneer Pakoda [6 Pcs]
info.description: Paneer Pakora features cubes of paneer cheese coated in a spiced gram flour batter and fried to a crispy golden-brown. Each pakora offers a crunchy texture with a soft, creamy cheese center.

info.name: Vegetable Samosa [1 Pc]
info.description: Vegetable Samosa is a savory pastry filled with a spiced mixture of potatoes, peas, and herbs, wrapped in a crispy pastry shell. Each piece offers a delightful crunch with a flavorful, spiced filling.

info.name: Aloo Chaat
info.description: Aloo Chaat is a spicy, tangy dish made from diced, fried potatoes mixed with tamarind chutney, yogurt, and spices. This street food favorite offers a burst of flavors and textures, combining sweetness, tanginess, and spiciness.

info.name: Cheese Pineapple Stick
info.description: Cheese Pineapple Stick features skewers of cheese and pineapple chunks grilled or baked to perfection. The sweet pineapple and savory cheese create a delightful contrast of flavors, making it a unique and tasty appetizer.

info.name: Paneer Cutlet [2 Pcs]
info.description: Paneer Cutlet consists of spiced paneer (Indian cheese) mixed with herbs and vegetables, then shaped into patties and fried. These cutlets offer a crispy exterior with a soft, flavorful interior, making them a delicious and satisfying snack or appetizer.

info.name: Vegetable Cutlet [2 Pcs]
info.description: Vegetable Cutlet consists of spiced and mashed vegetables formed into patties and fried to a crispy golden-brown. These cutlets offer a flavorful, crunchy exterior with a tender and spiced interior, perfect as a snack or appetizer.

info.name: Finger Chips
info.description: Finger Chips are crispy, golden-brown potato sticks, deep-fried to a perfect crunch. Seasoned with a touch of salt, these chips are a popular and satisfying side or snack, ideal for dipping in ketchup or other sauces.

info.name: Egg Pakoda [5 Pcs]
info.description: Egg Pakora consists of hard-boiled eggs dipped in a spiced gram flour batter and fried until crispy. The crunchy coating complements the smooth, savory egg, making it a delicious and satisfying snack.

info.name: Savoury Omelette
info.description: Savoury Omelette features eggs cooked with a mix of vegetables, herbs, and spices. The result is a fluffy, flavorful omelette that's perfect for breakfast or a light meal.

info.name: Cheese Omelette
info.description: Cheese Omelette offers a choice of tender chicken or melted cheese mixed into a fluffy egg omelette. Seasoned with herbs and spices, it provides a hearty and satisfying option for breakfast or a light meal.

info.name: Chicken Omelette

info.description: Fish Fingers,served with fried pototo wedges are breaded and fried strips of fish, offering a crispy coating with a tender, flaky interior. Served with a dipping sauce, these are a popular and easy-to-enjoy seafood appetizer.

info.name: Papad
info.description: Papad is a crisp, thin Indian cracker made from lentil or chickpea flour and seasoned with spices. Its typically roasted or fried to a crunchy texture, providing a light, flavorful crunch that pairs well with dips and main courses.

info.name: Masala Papad
info.description: Masala Papad features crispy papad topped with a spicy, tangy mixture of tomatoes, onions, and herbs. This flavorful appetizer offers a satisfying crunch with a burst of fresh, zesty flavors.

info.name: Mixed Raita
info.description: Mixed Raita is a cooling yogurt-based side dish mixed with a variety of vegetables and spices. It offers a refreshing contrast to spicy dishes, with a creamy texture and a balanced blend of flavors.

info.name: Aloo Raita
info.description: Creamy yogurt mixed with spiced, diced potatoes for a cooling, tangy side.

info.name: Kheera Raita
info.description: Refreshing yogurt blended with crisp cucumber and a hint of cumin.

info.name: Onion Raita
info.description: Tangy yogurt combined with crunchy onions and aromatic spices for a zesty accompaniment.

info.name: Pineapple Raita
info.description: Sweet pineapple chunks folded into creamy yogurt with a touch of spices for a tropical twist.

info.name: Creme Caramel
info.description: Cream Caramel is a smooth and creamy dessert with a rich caramel flavor. The custard is topped with a glossy caramel sauce, offering a sweet and indulgent treat with a silky texture.

info.name: Mousse of the Day
info.description: Mousse of the Day is a light, airy dessert featuring a velvety mousse made from a variety of flavors. Each day offers a different flavor, providing a delightful and refreshing end to your meal.
